notes.source: NFL Network (Cameron Wolfe) via heavy.com Week 2 workload report; Sharp Football Analysis 2025 run-D splits; SI.com Bills Week 2 injury report (all Sep 2026)
notes.text: Gibbs had a career-high 34 touches in Week 1 and Lions beat reporters say the plan is to get him 'close to that' again Thursday vs Buffalo -- not a scaled-back role. Bills' run defense allowed 5.0 YPC (30th) and an explosive run on 12.5% of RB carries (30th) last season, and enter this game thin up front (Ed Oliver has a spotty availability history; DL depth piece T.J. Sanders out sick, not injury-related). Both signals support the workload/opportunity side of the TD prop; neither is a red-zone-carry-share stat specifically, so kept to a modest +2pt nudge rather than a bigger one.

notes.text: Chiefs are without starting LT Josh Simmons (back) and starting SS Chamarri Conner (knee), both ruled out on the final injury report -- a real pass-protection dent for Mahomes even though several other starters (Chris Jones, L'Jarius Sneed, Xavier Worthy, Rashee Rice) are playing through lesser injuries.
